answer_1.quote: We develop a unified agent skilled in goal-oriented multi-turn conversations and function calling... CoALM models demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on both TOD and LA domains.
answer_1.outputs: generated multi-turn dialogues with reasoning steps and function-call JSON structures

answer_2.quote: we measure Success Rate and Joint Goal Accuracy (JGA); BFCL provides AST accuracy and Executable Function Accuracy; API-Bank uses Rouge-L1; we also report MMLU, ARC, GSM8K, HellaSwag scores.

answer_4.quote: it is also validated by human evaluators (Appendix D)... We asked a senior Computer Science student to evaluate these generated dialogues across four key dimensions: Undefined Function Call, Incorrect Argument Type, Argument Hallucination, Low-Quality Reasoning and Planning.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators checked each dialogue for undefined function calls, incorrect argument types, argument hallucinations, and low-quality reasoning/planning.
